title: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2611.11588v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In financial backtesting and other point-in-time tasks, external inputs can be restricted by date, but model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, introducing parametric look-ahead bias. We introduce FinCutBench, a continually updated monthly financial knowledge benchmark for measuring how far a fixed model's financial knowledge extends over calendar time. The current dataset contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option multiple-choice questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information. We construct monthly knowledge profiles using the approximate months in which the tested facts became public. After a profile passes the decline test and knot checks, we define the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level, and report the stability of the estimated date under resampling. Boundary dates and localization

translated_title: FinCutBench：一个用于衡量大语言模型金融知识时间边界的持续更新基准
translated_abstract: 在金融回测和其他时点任务中，外部输入可以按日期进行限制，但模型参数可能保留了之后才披露的金融事实，从而引入参数化前视偏差。我们提出了FinCutBench，这是一个每月持续更新的金融知识基准，用于衡量固定模型的金融知识在日历时间上能够延伸到多远。当前数据集包含9,000道中英文四选一多项选择题，时间跨度从2023年1月至2026年9月，涵盖中国和美国市场以及四类金融信息。我们利用所测试事实公开的大致月份来构建月度知识画像。在画像通过衰减测试和节点检查后，我们将FinCut边界定义为拟合画像达到其较低水平的第一个月份，并报告重采样下估计日期的稳定性。边界日期与定位
tldr: 该论文提出FinCutBench，一个每月持续更新的中英双语金融知识基准，通过按月构建知识画像并定位“FinCut边界”，来衡量大语言模型金融知识的时间截止点，以检测金融回测中的参数化前视偏差。
